info.description: Page Builder V1. Use with the "Page Builder - Local" environment. Run the whole collection in order (Runner / newman).

exec: pm.test("success envelope", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.meta.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("name trimmed, DRAFT, revision 1", () => { pm.expect(j.data.name).to.eql("Product Landing Page"); pm.expect(j.data.status).to.eql("DRAFT"); pm.expect(j.data.revision).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("BIGINT id is a string", () => pm.expect(j.data.id).to.be.a("string"));

const ids = ["hero","features","images","testimonials","pricing","faq","cta","form"].map(t => pm.collectionVariables.get("sec_" + t)).reverse(); pm.collectionVariables.set("reversedIds", JSON.stringify(ids)); pm.variables.set("reorderBody", JSON.stringify({ sectionIds: ids }));

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get("baseUrl") + "/api/v1/pages/" + pm.collectionVariables.get("pageId") + "/draft", method: "GET", header: { Authorization: "Bearer " + pm.environment.get("token"), "X-Workspace-Id": pm.environment.get("workspaceId") } }, (e, r) => { if (!e && r.code === 200) pm.collectionVariables.set("revision", String(r.json().data.revision)); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get("baseUrl") + "/api/v1/pages/" + pm.collectionVariables.get("pageId") + "/draft", method: "GET", header: { Authorization: "Bearer " + pm.environment.get("token"), "X-Workspace-Id": pm.environment.get("workspaceId") } }, (e, r) => { if (!e && r.code === 200) { const cur = r.json().data.revision; pm.collectionVariables.set("revision", String(cur)); pm.collectionVariables.set("staleRevision", String(Math.max(1, cur - 1))); } });
pm.test("revision unchanged by the rejected write", () => pm.expect(j.data.revision).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("revision"))));

pm.test("content refs match sections that carry one", () => pm.expect(j.data.contentReferences).to.eql(j.data.sections.filter(s => s.contentRef).map(s => ({ sectionId: s.id, type: s.type, contentRef: s.contentRef }))));

item.name: Duplicated page has new section IDs

exec: const orig = TYPES_IDS(); function TYPES_IDS() { return ["hero","features","images","testimonials","pricing","faq","cta","form"].map(t => pm.collectionVariables.get("sec_" + t)); }
pm.test("8 sections, none shared with original", () => { pm.expect(j.data.sections.length).to.eql(8); pm.expect(j.data.sections.some(s => orig.includes(s.id))).to.eql(false); });
